summary: list | run <name> | apply | enable | disable | status — scheduler-neutral jobs (§15); apply renders launchd plists, enable activates them
hints: Scheduler-neutral jobs: list/run/apply/enable/disable/status. Only read/safe_write may be scheduled. `apply` renders the plists; `enable` installs + loads them into launchd (confirm-class — needs --yes); `status` shows rendered/installed/loaded per job. Common mistake: a job with inline shell logic — a job calls exactly ONE verb.
